profile.faq.heading: Questions about these changes
profile.faq.updateEmailQ: What happens when I change my email address?
profile.faq.updateEmailA: We send a confirmation link to the new address and leave your account on the old one until you follow it. Once confirmed, the new address is what you sign in with, and every order confirmation, payment link and invoice goes there.
profile.faq.whenAppliesQ: When does the change take effect?
profile.faq.whenAppliesA: The moment the link is followed, and not before. Confirming an email address also signs you out on every device, because the address is your sign-in identity — sign back in with the new one.
profile.faq.historyQ: Do I lose my order history?
profile.faq.historyA: No. Your orders, invoices, saved addresses, scheduled orders and saved cards all stay exactly as they are. Changing a contact detail changes where we write to you and nothing else.
profile.faq.phoneCodeQ: Why does the number confirmation arrive by email?
profile.faq.phoneCodeA: This store has no text-message provider configured, so the link is sent to your email address instead. It proves the change came from you, which is what stops somebody else altering the number on your account.
profile.faq.ordersInFlightQ: What about an order that is already on its way?
profile.faq.ordersInFlightA: It is unaffected. An order keeps the delivery details captured when it was placed, so changing a number here does not redirect a delivery already in progress. Contact us if a delivery has to be redirected.

erp.hub.title: ERP integration
erp.hub.description: Connect your own purchasing system so that what you buy here appears there, without anybody re-typing it.
erp.hub.unavailableBody: {{store}} has not switched on customer ERP connections. Ask them whether it can be enabled for your account.
erp.hub.noneBody: Connect SAP, monday.com or your own API, and the orders you place here will appear in it as purchase orders.

erp.hub.approvalsWaitingBody: Nothing has been sent to your system yet. Each of these goes when somebody approves it, and is cancelled rather than sent late if nobody does.
erp.hub.benefitPurchaseOrder: An order you confirm here raises a purchase order in your own system, with the same lines and references.
erp.hub.benefitStock: The quantity goes to on order. It only becomes stock on hand when the goods are receipted.
erp.hub.benefitInvoice: Invoices arrive with their number, amounts, tax and due date, ready for your accounts payable.
erp.hub.benefitNoRetyping: Nobody re-keys a purchase order, which is where most ordering mistakes come from.
erp.system.sapDescription: S/4HANA or SAP ERP, over the OData or REST APIs a communication arrangement exposes. Works with an on-premise system behind your Cloud Connector.
erp.system.mondayDescription: A board for purchase orders, a group per status, columns for SKU and quantity. Sign in and choose the board.
erp.system.odooDescription: Odoo Online or a self-hosted Odoo, over its JSON-RPC interface. Purchase orders, stock moves and vendor bills, against the database you name.
erp.system.customDescription: Anything with a documented HTTP API. REST and JSON by default, with OData and GraphQL where your system speaks them.
erp.auth.clientCredentialsNote: A machine-to-machine grant with no person involved. The right answer for SAP, and it keeps working when staff change.
erp.auth.authorizationCodeNote: You sign in to your own system and approve the permissions listed. Nothing here ever sees your password.
erp.auth.apiKeyNote: A key your system issues, sent with every request. Tell us the header or parameter name it expects.
erp.auth.bearerTokenNote: A token sent in the Authorization header. Simple, and it has to be replaced by hand when it expires.
erp.auth.basicNote: Offered because some systems still require it. It has no expiry and no scope, so use one of the others where your system allows it.
erp.auth.mondayPersonalTokenNote: Carries one person's whole monday.com account and does not stop working when they leave. Test connections only.
erp.network.publicHttpsNote: Your system answers on a public HTTPS address. Nothing for your IT team to open up.
erp.network.ipAllowlistNote: Public, but your firewall admits only known addresses. Ask your supplier which addresses to allow.
erp.network.vpnGateway: Through a VPN or private link
erp.network.vpnGatewayNote: You terminate a private connection at a gateway and give us that gateway's public address.
erp.network.sapCloudConnectorNote: Your SAP is on-premise and reached through a connector you run. Give us the connector's address, not SAP's.
erp.role.ownerNote: As an owner you can change the connection, its credentials and who else has access.
erp.role.integrationManagerNote: As an integration manager you can set up and run the connection. Only an owner can change who has access.
erp.role.memberNote: You can see how the connection is doing and read its history. An owner or an integration manager makes changes.

erp.join.noToken: This link is missing its invitation code. Open the link from the email exactly as it was sent.
erp.oauth.title: Connecting your system
erp.oauth.doneBody: {{connection}} is now connected. You can test it and switch it on.
erp.oauth.doneBodyWithScope: {{connection}} is now connected. Your system granted these permissions: {{scope}}.
erp.oauth.refusedTitle: You did not approve the connection
erp.oauth.refusedBody: Nothing was connected. You can start again from the connection whenever you are ready.
erp.oauth.incompleteBody: This page only works when your own system sends you here. Start again from the connection.
erp.oauth.failedTitle: The connection could not be finished
erp.oauth.failedBody: Your system could not be connected. Start again from the connection.
erp.wizard.title: Connect a system
erp.wizard.description: Six steps. Nothing is sent to your system until you switch the connection on at the end.
erp.wizard.systemBody: Which system are we connecting to, and is this your test system or your live one?
erp.wizard.presetSearchHint: Search by name. If yours is not listed, choose Any other system - anything with a documented API can be connected.
erp.wizard.presetNoMatch: Nothing matches that name. Clear the search and choose Any other system - if your ERP has a documented API or a middleware endpoint, it can still be connected.
erp.wizard.presetExamplesNote: This system is set up differently for every customer, so the addresses we fill in are a starting point rather than your own. Ask whoever implemented it for your integration API documentation - or paste their OpenAPI file on the Endpoints step - and check each path before you switch the connection on.
erp.wizard.name: Connection name
erp.wizard.nameHint: What you will call it here. Your colleagues see this name.
erp.wizard.erpVersionHint: The release you are on, if you know it. It helps us suggest the right defaults.
erp.wizard.environmentHint: A test system can raise purchase orders in your sandbox. It can never change what you believe about stock.
erp.wizard.connectionBody: Where your system is, and how it should let us in.
erp.wizard.baseUrlHint: The HTTPS address of your API. We check it before every call and never follow it anywhere private.
erp.wizard.apiVersionHint: Where your system wants one. Leave blank if it does not.
erp.wizard.apiKeyNameHint: The header or parameter name your system expects, exactly as it spells it.
erp.wizard.scopeHint: Ask for the least your system will accept. We show you what it actually granted.
erp.wizard.redirectUriBody: Register this address in your own system as the place to send you back to:
erp.wizard.mappingRejected: These rows need attention before the mapping can be saved:
erp.wizard.noAuthMethod: This system cannot be connected as a live connection here. Choose a test connection above, or ask your supplier to register an application with it.
erp.wizard.leaveBlankToKeep: Leave blank to keep what is stored.
erp.wizard.platformAppNote: Nothing to enter. This store has registered an application with monday.com, so you sign in and approve the permissions instead of typing a secret.
erp.wizard.sapPlacementBody: SAP will not accept a purchase order without a company code and a purchasing organisation. Your purchasing team will know both.
erp.wizard.mondayPlacementBody: The board new purchase orders are added to, and the group within it.
erp.wizard.customHeadersHint: One per line, as Name: value. Put anything secret in the credentials above instead.
erp.wizard.tenantIdentifierHint: How your system knows this supplier, if it uses a code.
erp.wizard.networkBody: How we reach your system. This does not change what we do; it tells your IT team what to set up.
erp.wizard.httpsRequired: HTTPS is required either way. Your credentials travel with every request, so we will not use an unencrypted address.
erp.wizard.networkNotesHint: Anything worth recording: which virtual host the connector maps, which gateway terminates the link.
erp.wizard.endpointsBody: Which address does what. Each one has to be on the same host as the connection itself.
erp.wizard.importSpecBody: Paste your OpenAPI document, in JSON or YAML. We suggest which endpoint does what and you confirm it. Nothing is saved until you continue.
erp.wizard.specImported_one: Found {{count}} endpoint. Check each one before you continue.
erp.wizard.specImported_other: Found {{count}} endpoints. Check each one before you continue.
erp.wizard.recordsPathHint: The field holding the list, if the answer wraps it. Leave blank and we will find it.
erp.wizard.mappingBody: Your field names against ours. Press Test and preview to check them against a real record from your system.
erp.wizard.mappingOk: Every required field was found in your data.
erp.wizard.rulesBody: What may move, in which direction, and who has to say yes first.
erp.wizard.activateHint: Switching on needs a test that passed and a mapping checked against real data. Until then, nothing is sent.
erp.rules.sourceOfTruthHint: When the two disagree about a figure, whose do you believe?
erp.rules.directionHint: Both ways needs an answer to who wins, which is the setting above.
erp.rules.outbound: We send to your system only
erp.rules.inbound: We read from your system only
erp.rules.conflictHint: Ask is the honest answer while you are still migrating.
erp.rules.stockWritesHint: Whether a goods receipt updates your stock on its own, or waits for somebody.
erp.rules.sandboxLocked: A test system cannot write stock automatically. It can raise purchase orders in your sandbox, and what it believes about stock must not become what you believe about stock.
erp.rules.thresholdHint: Leave blank to send every order straight through.
erp.rules.sendPurchaseOrders: Raise a purchase order when an order is confirmed
erp.rules.sendShipmentStatus: Send the carrier and tracking when it ships
erp.rules.sendGoodsReceipts: Post a goods receipt when it arrives
erp.rules.sendInvoices: Send invoices with their number, amounts and due date
erp.rules.sendPaymentReferences: Send the payment reference when it settles
erp.rules.syncInventory: Read stock levels from your system
erp.rules.receiptOnDelivery: Treat our delivery as the goods receipt, instead of waiting for yours
erp.rules.warehousesHint: Which of our warehouses is which of your plants. Leave one blank and we will use your default.
product.priceOnRequestBody: We price this one per account. Tell {{store}} what you need and how often, and we will quote you.
product.currentlyUnavailable: This product cannot be ordered at the moment.
packaging.heading: Packaging and ordering
packaging.notAMinimum: Pack sizes are how this is boxed, not a minimum order. Any minimum is shown under Ordering information.
packaging.needsConfirming: The supplier wrote “{{source}}”, and those figures do not multiply out. We are confirming them, so this one can only be ordered by the piece for now.
packaging.unitNotStated: Sizes are shown as the supplier recorded them. Where no unit is given, none was stated.
errors.pricedOnRequest: This one is priced per account, so it cannot go straight into a basket. Ask us for a quotation and we will price it for you.
errors.notOrderable: This product cannot be ordered at the moment.
errors.packSizeUnknown: We have not recorded how many pieces are in a pack of this product yet, so it can only be ordered by the piece for now.
